paper.title: Genetic-algorithm-based layout optimization of an offshore wind farm under real seabed terrain encountering an engineering cost model
paper.authors: Zhenqing Liu and Shuanglong Fan and Yize Wang and Jie Peng

public_asset_candidate_evidence.status: no target source or Nanao arrays found; cited same-author CC0 archive inspected and used only to complete GA settings

paper_source_conflicts: Eq.1 is L-infinity square separation although the prose calls it physical 5D distance.
Eq.7 states per-MW transformer costs but omits the number of turbines from full-farm capacity.
Eqs.9-10 define design and infrastructure as shares of ICC, requiring an implicit solve.
Eq.11 is initial capital divided by instantaneous expected MW, not lifecycle LCOE.
The stated 0-25 count admits zero although Eq.11 is undefined without a turbine.
S1W1 and S1W3 both have 18 turbines at zero support depth, but paper COE times displayed power implies about GBP139.8m and GBP244.3m ICC. S1W2/S1W4 contradict in the same way at 23 turbines.
missing_information: target layout source, exact MATLAB options, random state, seeds, convergence trace and result archive
exact variable-count chromosome, selection, crossover, mutation, constraint handling and initialization
rated power and ambient turbulence used in optimization
numeric S5 Nanao bathymetry and W1-W4 direction-speed-probability arrays
target code's exact Qian-Ishihara composition and original optimized coordinates
completion_decisions: Use the 20 unique S1-S5 by W1-W4 optimizations and sixteen Figure-11-style layout transfers.
Use population100, crossover0.3 and 500 generations from the cited same-author CC0 MATLAB scripts; one formal run per case follows the paper presentation.
Complete rank selection, five elites, scattered crossover, bounded count/coordinate mutation and count-preserving deterministic spacing repair.
Restore Euclidean 5D as the production physics while retaining literal L-infinity spacing as a named audit mode.
Restore full-farm transformer capacity and solve implicit ICC algebraically.
Use rated power2.3MW for printed capital scale and ambient TI0.08 for the offshore wake completion.
Use S1-S4 paper forms, normalized S4 moments, and a frozen irregular S5 analytic proxy with the same mean and standard deviation.
Use normalized W2-W4 analytic digitizations whose no-wake per-turbine power matches the visible Table7-10 scale.
Retain every result-table anchor and report discrepancies without wind-dependent capital calibration.
Use one persistent full-core team for frozen-generation creation and independent complete-layout evaluation with ordered commits.

scope.claim_boundary: source-backed flexible academic reconstruction of the complete target problem, GA, twenty native cases and sixteen transfers; not author code, private Nanao arrays, MATLAB trajectory or numerical replay

decision_variables.resolution: one to twenty-five continuous 2D turbine coordinates

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: variable-length count plus canonical continuous coordinate sequence

constraints_and_repair.resolution: Euclidean 500m production spacing, literal L-infinity sensitivity, count-preserving bounded repair

objective_and_direction.resolution: minimize initial-capital-to-expected-power GBP per MW proxy

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Gaussian velocity and added-turbulence propagation, cubic power, terrain support and corrected engineering capital

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: W1 literal and normalized W2-W4 analytic proxies with matching no-wake per-turbine power scales

paper_native_cases.resolution: twenty S1-S5 by W1-W4 optimizations and sixteen S1-layout transfers

parameters.resolution: population100 generations500 crossover0.3 elites5 and bounded adaptive mutation

update_order.resolution: rank selection, frozen offspring, full evaluation, stable ranking and elite survival

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: 500 complete generations; physical FES equals population times generations plus initial population

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: count, capital, expected power, efficiency, spacing, timing, workers, FES and hash; one run per native case

training_and_inference_lifecycle.resolution: genetic algorithm has no trained model

development_h6_20260801.comparison_boundary: same final pure-C++ implementation with one versus twenty Spark workers; not MATLAB, author code or Waffle confirmation
